svg.title: The Sixty-Five Thousand Doors: An Epic of Ports
svg.desc: Two process arrows thread through a grid of small door silhouettes toward one large central door crossed with a blocking X—the first enters, the second is stopped dead by a rejection bar—while a port-range axis below marks its specific address near the far-left end of sixty-five thousand ticks. Trace Bloom generative banner for “The Sixty-Five Thousand Doors: An Epic of Ports”. A organic lattice probed by 3 emitters; interference blooms mark where the wavefronts meet. Seed 4147150187.
